g_policy.reason: The user taps a button to opt in, the offer copy states the reward (1 extra streak freeze this week), declining changes nothing, and the button is hidden if no game is ready.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is one streak freeze that lasts until the end of the week. It has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: a Plus member with no freeze left opens the app on a day without a workout, which opens the s02 pop-up. No chat content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal says it removes nothing free, and nothing in the flow caps or locks anything users get today. The weekly freeze stays as it is.

g_brand_safety.reason: The button sits in the s02 modal over s01 Today, a non-chat screen. Both screens are rated safe, and the offer is not inside any conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor proposal, and the app limits streak freezes to one a week (m02, l01 'Streak freezes: 0 of 1 left this week'). The reward gives exactly that limited resource.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the weekly freeze, the 'No streak freezes left this week' text, the Plus benefits (plans and heart-rate stats only) and the trial button are backed by s01.e02, s02.e02, s03.e03, s03.e04 and s02.e04. The new button, copy and reward are the proposal's own changes.

c3_spares_payers.reason: Plus members are shown an offer for streak freezes, which the plan does not include (m03 lists only plans and heart-rate stats). The plan does not remove ads, and the offer is not in a paid-only feature or pitched as more of what the plan sells.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is one freeze that expires at the end of the week. It gives away none of the plan's main benefit and takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears in the streak-about-to-break pop-up, which is a moment of need because the freeze is used up and the streak ends at midnight.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn game. The freeze is granted only when the game counts (no freeze if it doesn't), and the trigger is a detectable app event that opens s02.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the streak freeze meter (s01.e02), the streak-about-to-break pop-up (s02), and Fitness Plus's benefits. It would not read the same in another app.

other_concern: Offering this only to Plus members is an odd choice: free users, who are more likely to lose the streak, see no such offer. The model also doesn't say whether Plus members see the s02 pop-up.
